coverage.design_evaluation_explanation: Matches 3 of 6 core variable categories (50%): use of Docta for label cleaning, raw versus Docta-cleaned training data, and F1/predictive performance measurement. The metric match is broad rather than specific to toxicity classification.
coverage.design_error_analysis: Replaces Anthropic Harmless and Red Team datasets with unrelated classification benchmarks, and BERT/GPT-2 with RoBERTa/DeBERTa. Does not evaluate predictive performance separately on ChatGPT Cleaned and Human Sampled test sets; human and ChatGPT judgments instead assess label disagreements. Adds unsupported experimental conditions and metrics, and omits the toxicity-specific and Tables 6–7 context.
coverage.conclusion_evaluation_explanation: The conclusion_output is empty, so it does not semantically match the ground-truth conclusion.
coverage.conclusion_error_analysis: Fails to state that Docta-cleaned training data should significantly improve F1 on both specified evaluation subsets, supporting improved label credibility through reduced raw-label inconsistencies.
